{{Quote|Lord Vader, there's been an incident at the Yaga Minor shipyards.|Luitt, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Lords" />}}
'''Yaga Minor''' was an industrialized [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] where [[Yaga Minor shipyards|shipyards]] were located. A [[Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate Base|base]] of the [[Ubiqtorate]], the [[Galactic Empire]]'s military intelligence branch, was also located at the planet.

==Description==
Yaga Minor was an industrialized [[planet]]<ref name="Battles" /> located within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> Situated at the coordinates K-5 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was connected by the [[Entralla Route]] to the [[Borosk system]] and [[Entralla system]].<ref name="Galaxy Map">{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|These attacks on Yaga Minor are suicidal—|A senior member of the 204th|<ref name="Shadow Fall">''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Yaga Minor hosted some [[Yaga Minor shipyards|shipyards]],<ref name="Lords" /> as well as a [[Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate Base|base]] for the Imperial military intelligence branch known as the [[Ubiqtorate]]. The Yaga Minor Ubiqtorate base kept records on [[Star Destroyer]]s produced by the [[Kuat Drive Yards]] manufacturing corporation that were based there.<ref name="Rise" />

In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="14 BBY">The events of ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' are dated to [[14 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> members of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] rebel cell, led by the [[Twi'lek]] [[Pok (Twi'lek)|Pok]], [[Mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment|hijacked]] an Imperial weapons shipment at the Yaga Minor shipyards and fled into [[hyperspace]]. The incident was reported to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] by the Imperial [[Captain]] [[Luitt]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Perilous]]'', and Vader pursued and [[Death|slaughtered]] Pok and his crew.<ref name="Lords" />

By [[5 ABY]],<ref name="5 ABY">{{ShadowFallDate}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[New Republic]], Yaga Minor was the site of conflict. Prior to the start of a meeting aboard the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] ''[[Aerie]]'', a senior member of the Empire's [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]] present called the attacks on Yaga Minor suicidal during some discussions in the room between the attendees.<ref name="Shadow Fall" />

In the [[New Republic Era|time]] of the New Republic, Yaga Minor was eventually part of the [[First Order]]'s official territory.<ref name="Battles" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="35 ABY">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] referenced several records obtained from Yaga Minor in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''.<ref name="Rise" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Yaga Minor was first mentioned in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Lords" /> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] was first mentioned in the [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> before later first appearing in Zhan's [[1997]] novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', the first instalment of the ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> In the [[1998]] [[Coolhand Interactive]] video game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], a generic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] image was used to depict Yaga Minor and a number of other planets.<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>
